#include <windows.h>
#include <minhook.h>
#include <d3d12.h>
#include <dxgi1_6.h>
#include <imgui.h>
#include <imgui_impl_dx12.h>
#include <imgui_impl_win32.h>

// Forward declarations
LRESULT CALLBACK WndProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
HRESULT WINAPI HookedPresent(IDXGISwapChain* pThis, UINT SyncInterval, UINT Flags);

// Original Present function pointer
HRESULT (WINAPI* OriginalPresent)(IDXGISwapChain*, UINT, UINT);

// Window handle
HWND g_hWnd = NULL;

// Direct3D 12 resources
ID3D12Device* g_pd3dDevice = NULL;
ID3D12CommandQueue* g_pd3dCommandQueue = NULL;
ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* g_pd3dCommandList = NULL;
ID3D12CommandAllocator* g_pd3dCommandAllocator = NULL;
ID3D12DescriptorHeap* g_pd3dRtvDescHeap = NULL;
ID3D12DescriptorHeap* g_pd3dSrvDescHeap = NULL;
UINT g_nFrameIndex = 0;

// ImGui resources
ImGuiIO* g_io = NULL;
ImGui_ImplWin32_Init(g_hWnd);
ImGui_ImplDX12_Init(g_pd3dDevice, 1, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, g_pd3dSrvDescHeap, g_pd3dSrvDescHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), g_pd3dSrvDescHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());

// Hooked Present function
HRESULT WINAPI HookedPresent(IDXGISwapChain* pThis, UINT SyncInterval, UINT Flags) {
    // Call the original Present function
    HRESULT hr = OriginalPresent(pThis, SyncInterval, Flags);

    // ImGui rendering
    ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame();
    ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
    ImGui::NewFrame();

    ImGui::Begin("EldenCraft Overlay");
    ImGui::Text("EldenCraft Loaded!");
    ImGui::End();

    ImGui::Render();
    ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData());

    return hr;
}

// DLL entry point
BOOL APIENTRY DllMain(HMODULE hModule, DWORD ul_reason_for_call, LPVOID lpReserved) {
    switch (ul_reason_for_call) {
    case DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH:
        DisableThreadLibraryCalls(hModule);

        // Initialize MinHook
        MH_Initialize();

        // Create window
        WNDCLASSEX wc = { sizeof(WNDCLASSEX), CS_HREDRAW | CS_VREDRAW, WndProc, 0, 0, hModule, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, L"EldenCraftOverlay", NULL };
        RegisterClassEx(&wc);
        g_hWnd = CreateWindow(L"EldenCraftOverlay", L"EldenCraft Overlay", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, 800, 600, NULL, NULL, hModule, NULL);

        // Initialize Direct3D 12
        D3D12CreateDevice(NULL, D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_HARDWARE, &g_pd3dDevice);
        g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandQueue(D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC{ D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_PRIORITY_NORMAL, 0, 0 }, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dCommandQueue));
        g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dCommandAllocator));
        g_pd3dDevice->CreateDescriptorHeap(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC{ D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV, 1, D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, 0 }, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dRtvDescHeap));
        g_pd3dDevice->CreateDescriptorHeap(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC{ D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV, 1, D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE, 0 }, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dSrvDescHeap));

        // Hook IDXGISwapChain::Present
        OriginalPresent = (HRESULT (WINAPI*)(IDXGISwapChain*, UINT, UINT))MH_CreateHook((LPVOID)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandle(L"d3d12.dll"), "Present"), (LPVOID)HookedPresent, (LPVOID*)&OriginalPresent);
        MH_EnableHook((LPVOID)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandle(L"d3d12.dll"), "Present"));

        break;
    case DLL_THREAD_ATTACH:
    case DLL_THREAD_DETACH:
    case DLL_PROCESS_DETACH:
        break;
    }
    return TRUE;
}

// Window procedure
LRESULT CALLBACK WndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    switch (msg) {
    case WM_DESTROY:
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        break;
    default:
        return DefWindowProc(hWnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return 0;
}

        break;

}

    case WM_DESTROY:
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        break;
    default:
        return DefWindowProc(hWnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return 0;
}

typedef HRESULT(WINAPI* Present_t)(IDXGISwapChain* pSwapChain, UINT SyncInterval, UINT Flags);
Present_t OriginalPresent = nullptr;

struct FrameContext {
    ID3D12CommandAllocator* CommandAllocator;
    ID3D12Resource* MainRenderTargetResource;
    D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE MainRenderTargetDescriptor;
};

static FrameContext* g_frameContexts = nullptr;
static UINT g_bufferCount = 0;
static ID3D12Device* g_pd3dDevice = nullptr;
static ID3D12CommandQueue* g_pCommandQueue = nullptr;
static ID3D12DescriptorHeap* g_pd3dSrvDescHeap = nullptr;
static ID3D12DescriptorHeap* g_pd3dRtvDescHeap = nullptr;
static ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* g_pd3dCommandList = nullptr;
static HWND g_hWnd = nullptr;
static bool g_isInitialized = false;

extern IMGUI_IMPL_API LRESULT ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler(HWND hWnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam);

HRESULT WINAPI HookedPresent(IDXGISwapChain* pSwapChain, UINT SyncInterval, UINT Flags) {
    if (!g_isInitialized) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] HookedPresent triggered, initializing ImGui...");
        if (SUCCEEDED(pSwapChain->GetDevice(__uuidof(ID3D12Device), (void**)&g_pd3dDevice))) {
            DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC desc;
            pSwapChain->GetDesc(&desc);
            g_hWnd = desc.OutputWindow;
            g_bufferCount = desc.BufferCount;

            // Get exact back buffer format
            DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1 desc1;
            DXGI_FORMAT rtvFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
            IDXGISwapChain1* pSwapChain1 = nullptr;
            if (SUCCEEDED(pSwapChain->QueryInterface(&pSwapChain1))) {
                pSwapChain1->GetDesc1(&desc1);
                rtvFormat = desc1.Format;
                pSwapChain1->Release();
            } else {
                rtvFormat = desc.BufferDesc.Format;
            }
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] SwapChain RTV Format: %d", rtvFormat);

            // Create our own private command queue for ImGui rendering
            D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC queueDesc = {};
            queueDesc.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT;
            queueDesc.Flags = D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_FLAG_NONE;
            if (FAILED(g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandQueue(&queueDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pCommandQueue)))) {
                LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to create private command queue!");
                return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
            }
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Private command queue created successfully: 0x%p", g_pCommandQueue);

            // Create RTV Descriptor Heap
            D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC rtvDesc = {};
            rtvDesc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV;
            rtvDesc.NumDescriptors = g_bufferCount;
            rtvDesc.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_NONE;
            if (FAILED(g_pd3dDevice->CreateDescriptorHeap(&rtvDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dRtvDescHeap)))) {
                LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to create RTV descriptor heap!");
                return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
            }

            // Create SRV Descriptor Heap for ImGui
            D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC srvDesc = {};
            srvDesc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
            srvDesc.NumDescriptors = 1;
            srvDesc.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
            if (FAILED(g_pd3dDevice->CreateDescriptorHeap(&srvDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dSrvDescHeap)))) {
                LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to create SRV descriptor heap!");
                return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
            }

            SIZE_T rtvDescriptorSize = g_pd3dDevice->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV);
            D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtvHandle = g_pd3dRtvDescHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();

            g_frameContexts = new FrameContext[g_bufferCount];
            for (UINT i = 0; i < g_bufferCount; i++) {
                ID3D12Resource* pBackBuffer = nullptr;
                if (FAILED(pSwapChain->GetBuffer(i, IID_PPV_ARGS(&pBackBuffer)))) {
                    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to get back buffer!");
                    return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
                }
                if (FAILED(g_pd3dDevice->CreateRenderTargetView(pBackBuffer, nullptr, rtvHandle))) {
                    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to create render target view!");
                    return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
                }
                g_frameContexts[i].MainRenderTargetResource = pBackBuffer;
                g_frameContexts[i].MainRenderTargetDescriptor = rtvHandle;
                if (FAILED(g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_frameContexts[i].CommandAllocator)))) {
                    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to create command allocator!");
                    return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
                }
                rtvHandle.ptr += rtvDescriptorSize;
            }

            if (FAILED(g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, g_frameContexts[0].CommandAllocator, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dCommandList)))) {
                LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to create command list!");
                return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
            }
            g_pd3dCommandList->Close();

            IMGUI_CHECKVERSION();
            ImGui::CreateContext();
            ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO(); (void)io;

            ImGui_ImplWin32_Init(g_hWnd);

            ImGui_ImplDX12_InitInfo init_info = {};
            init_info.Device = g_pd3dDevice;
            init_info.CommandQueue = g_pCommandQueue;
            init_info.NumFramesInFlight = g_bufferCount;
            init_info.RTVFormat = rtvFormat;
            init_info.SrvDescriptorHeap = g_pd3dSrvDescHeap;
            init_info.LegacySingleSrvCpuDescriptor = g_pd3dSrvDescHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
            init_info.LegacySingleSrvGpuDescriptor = g_pd3dSrvDescHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();

            if (FAILED(ImGui_ImplDX12_Init(&init_info))) {
                LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to initialize ImGui!");
                return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
            }

            g_isInitialized = true;
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui fully initialized and ready!");
        }
    }

    if (g_isInitialized && g_pCommandQueue && g_pd3dCommandList) {
        IDXGISwapChain3* pSwapChain3 = nullptr;
        UINT frameIndex = 0;
        if (SUCCEEDED(pSwapChain->QueryInterface(&pSwapChain3))) {
            frameIndex = pSwapChain3->GetCurrentBackBufferIndex();
            pSwapChain3->Release();
        }

        FrameContext& currentFrameContext = g_frameContexts[frameIndex];
        if (FAILED(currentFrameContext.CommandAllocator->Reset())) {
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to reset command allocator!");
            return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
        }

        if (FAILED(g_pd3dCommandList->Reset(currentFrameContext.CommandAllocator, nullptr))) {
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to reset command list!");
            return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
        }

        // Transition back buffer to render target state
        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barrier = {};
        barrier.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
        barrier.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_FLAG_NONE;
        barrier.Transition.pResource = currentFrameContext.MainRenderTargetResource;
        barrier.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
        barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
        barrier.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
        if (FAILED(g_pd3dCommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier))) {
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to transition resource barrier!");
            return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
        }

        g_pd3dCommandList->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &currentFrameContext.MainRenderTargetDescriptor, FALSE, nullptr);
        g_pd3dCommandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, &g_pd3dSrvDescHeap);

        ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame();
        ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
        ImGui::NewFrame();

        ImGui::Begin("EldenCraft Overlay");
        ImGui::Text("EldenCraft Loaded Successfully!");
        ImGui::End();

        ImGui::Render();
        ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), g_pd3dCommandList);

        // Transition back buffer back to present state
        barrier.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
        barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
        if (FAILED(g_pd3dCommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier))) {
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to transition resource barrier!");
            return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
        }

        if (FAILED(g_pd3dCommandList->Close())) {
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to close command list!");
            return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
        }

        ID3D12CommandList* ppCommandLists[] = { g_pd3dCommandList };
        if (FAILED(g_pCommandQueue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, ppCommandLists))) {
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to execute command lists!");
            return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
        }
    }

    return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
}

        barrier.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
        barrier.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_FLAG_NONE;
        barrier.Transition.pResource = currentFrameContext.MainRenderTargetResource;

        barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
        g_pd3dCommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);

        g_pd3dCommandList->Close();

        ID3D12CommandList* ppCommandLists[] = { g_pd3dCommandList };
        g_pCommandQueue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, ppCommandLists);

    sd.BufferDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    sd.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;

    sd.Windowed = TRUE;
    sd.SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_FLIP_DISCARD;

    if (pSwapChain) {

        MH_EnableHook(pPresentAddr);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Hook enabled successfully.");

        pSwapChain->Release();
        pCommandQueue->Release();
        pDevice->Release();
        pFactory->Release();
    }

    DestroyWindow(hWnd);
    UnregisterClassW(wc.lpszClassName, wc.hInstance);
    return 0;
}

}

HRESULT WINAPI HookedPresent(IDXGISwapChain* pSwapChain, UINT SyncInterval, UINT Flags) {
    if (!g_isInitialized) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] HookedPresent triggered, initializing ImGui...");
        if (SUCCEEDED(pSwapChain->GetDevice(__uuidof(ID3D12Device), (void**)&g_pd3dDevice))) {
            DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC desc;
            pSwapChain->GetDesc(&desc);
            g_hWnd = desc.OutputWindow;
            g_bufferCount = desc.BufferCount;

            // Get exact back buffer format
            DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1 desc1;
            DXGI_FORMAT rtvFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
            IDXGISwapChain1* pSwapChain1 = nullptr;
            pSwapChain->QueryInterface(&pSwapChain1);
            pSwapChain1->GetDesc1(&desc1);
            rtvFormat = desc1.Format;
            pSwapChain1->Release();
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] SwapChain RTV Format: %d", rtvFormat);

            // Create our own private command queue for ImGui rendering
            D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC queueDesc = {};
            queueDesc.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT;
            queueDesc.Flags = D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_FLAG_NONE;
            g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandQueue(&queueDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pCommandQueue));
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Private command queue created successfully: 0x%p", g_pCommandQueue);

            // Create RTV Descriptor Heap
            D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC rtvDesc = {};
            rtvDesc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV;
            rtvDesc.NumDescriptors = g_bufferCount;
            rtvDesc.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_NONE;
            g_pd3dDevice->CreateDescriptorHeap(&rtvDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dRtvDescHeap));
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] RTV descriptor heap created successfully: 0x%p", g_pd3dRtvDescHeap);

            // Create SRV Descriptor Heap for ImGui
            D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC srvDesc = {};
            srvDesc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
            srvDesc.NumDescriptors = 1;
            srvDesc.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
            g_pd3dDevice->CreateDescriptorHeap(&srvDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dSrvDescHeap));
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] SRV descriptor heap created successfully: 0x%p", g_pd3dSrvDescHeap);

            SIZE_T rtvDescriptorSize = g_pd3dDevice->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV);
            D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtvHandle = g_pd3dRtvDescHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();

            g_frameContexts = new FrameContext[g_bufferCount];
            for (UINT i = 0; i < g_bufferCount; i++) {
                ID3D12Resource* pBackBuffer = nullptr;
                pSwapChain->GetBuffer(i, __uuidof(ID3D12Resource), (void**)&pBackBuffer);
                g_pd3dDevice->CreateRenderTargetView(pBackBuffer, nullptr, rtvHandle);
                g_frameContexts[i].MainRenderTargetResource = pBackBuffer;
                g_frameContexts[i].MainRenderTargetDescriptor = rtvHandle;
                g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_frameContexts[i].CommandAllocator));
                g_pd3dDevice->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_frameContexts[i].Fence));
                g_frameContexts[i].FenceValue = 0;
                rtvHandle.ptr += rtvDescriptorSize;
            }
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Frame contexts created successfully.");

            g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, g_frameContexts[0].CommandAllocator, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dCommandList));
            g_pd3dCommandList->Close();
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Command list created and closed successfully.");

            IMGUI_CHECKVERSION();
            ImGui::CreateContext();
            ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO(); (void)io;

            ImGui_ImplWin32_Init(g_hWnd);

            ImGui_ImplDX12_InitInfo init_info = {};
            init_info.Device = g_pd3dDevice;
            init_info.CommandQueue = g_pCommandQueue;
            init_info.NumFramesInFlight = g_bufferCount;
            init_info.RTVFormat = (DXGI_FORMAT)rtvFormat;
            init_info.DSVFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
            init_info.SrvDescriptorHeap = g_pd3dSrvDescHeap;
            ImGui_ImplDX12_Init(&init_info);
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui initialized successfully.");

            g_isInitialized = true;
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui fully initialized and ready!");
        }
    }

    if (g_isInitialized && g_pCommandQueue && g_pd3dCommandList) {
        IDXGISwapChain3* pSwapChain3 = nullptr;
        UINT frameIndex = 0;
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] QueryInterface for IDXGISwapChain3 and GetCurrentBackBufferIndex started.");
        pSwapChain->QueryInterface(&pSwapChain3);
        frameIndex = pSwapChain3->GetCurrentBackBufferIndex();
        pSwapChain3->Release();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] QueryInterface for IDXGISwapChain3 and GetCurrentBackBufferIndex completed.");

        // Safety bounds check
        if (frameIndex >= g_bufferCount) {
            frameIndex = 0;
        }

        FrameContext& currentFrameContext = g_frameContexts[frameIndex];
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandAllocator->Reset started.");
        currentFrameContext.CommandAllocator->Reset();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandAllocator->Reset completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandList->Reset started.");
        g_pd3dCommandList->Reset(currentFrameContext.CommandAllocator, nullptr);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandList->Reset completed.");

        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barrier = {};
        barrier.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
        barrier.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_FLAG_NONE;
        barrier.Transition.pResource = currentFrameContext.MainRenderTargetResource;
        barrier.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
        barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
        barrier.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Resource barrier (transitioning to render target) started.");
        g_pd3dCommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Resource barrier (transitioning to render target) completed.");

        g_pd3dCommandList->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &currentFrameContext.MainRenderTargetDescriptor, FALSE, nullptr);
        g_pd3dCommandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, &g_pd3dSrvDescHeap);

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame started.");
        ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame started.");
        ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui::NewFrame started.");
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui::NewFrame completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui::Render started.");
        ImGui::Render();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui::Render completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData started.");
        ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), g_pd3dCommandList);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData completed.");

        barrier.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
        barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Resource barrier (transitioning back to present) started.");
        g_pd3dCommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Resource barrier (transitioning back to present) completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandList->Close completed.");
        g_pd3dCommandList->Close();

        ID3D12CommandList* ppCommandLists[] = { g_pd3dCommandList };
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ExecuteCommandLists started.");
        g_pCommandQueue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, ppCommandLists);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ExecuteCommandLists completed.");

        // Signal the fence
        g_fenceValue++;
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Signal fence started.");
        g_pCommandQueue->Signal(currentFrameContext.Fence, g_fenceValue);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Signal fence completed.");

        // Wait for the fence
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Wait for fence started.");
        currentFrameContext.Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(g_fenceValue, g_fenceEvent);
        WaitForSingleObject(g_fenceEvent, INFINITE);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Wait for fence completed.");
    }

    // Call the original Present function to hand control back to Elden Ring
    return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
}

    if (!g_isInitialized) {

        if (SUCCEEDED(pSwapChain->GetDevice(__uuidof(ID3D12Device), (void**)&g_pd3dDevice))) {

            queueDesc.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT;
            queueDesc.Flags = D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_FLAG_NONE;
            g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandQueue(&queueDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pCommandQueue));
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Private command queue created successfully: 0x%p", g_pCommandQueue);

            D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC rtvDesc = {};
            rtvDesc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV;
            rtvDesc.NumDescriptors = g_bufferCount;

            g_pd3dDevice->CreateDescriptorHeap(&rtvDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dRtvDescHeap));
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] RTV descriptor heap created successfully: 0x%p", g_pd3dRtvDescHeap);

            // Create SRV Descriptor Heap for ImGui
            D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC srvDesc = {};
            srvDesc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
            srvDesc.NumDescriptors = 1;
            srvDesc.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
            g_pd3dDevice->CreateDescriptorHeap(&srvDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dSrvDescHeap));
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] SRV descriptor heap created successfully: 0x%p", g_pd3dSrvDescHeap);

            SIZE_T rtvDescriptorSize = g_pd3dDevice->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV);
            D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtvHandle = g_pd3dRtvDescHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();

            g_frameContexts = new FrameContext[g_bufferCount];
            for (UINT i = 0; i < g_bufferCount; i++) {
                ID3D12Resource* pBackBuffer = nullptr;
                pSwapChain->GetBuffer(i, __uuidof(ID3D12Resource), (void**)&pBackBuffer);
                g_pd3dDevice->CreateRenderTargetView(pBackBuffer, nullptr, rtvHandle);
                g_frameContexts[i].MainRenderTargetResource = pBackBuffer;
                g_frameContexts[i].MainRenderTargetDescriptor = rtvHandle;
                g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_frameContexts[i].CommandAllocator));
                g_pd3dDevice->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_frameContexts[i].Fence));
                g_frameContexts[i].FenceValue = 0;
                rtvHandle.ptr += rtvDescriptorSize;
            }
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Frame contexts created successfully.");

            g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, g_frameContexts[0].CommandAllocator, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dCommandList));
            g_pd3dCommandList->Close();
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Command list created and closed successfully.");

            IMGUI_CHECKVERSION();
            ImGui::CreateContext();
            ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO(); (void)io;

            init_info.NumFramesInFlight = g_bufferCount;
            init_info.RTVFormat = (DXGI_FORMAT)rtvFormat;
            init_info.DSVFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
            init_info.SrvDescriptorHeap = g_pd3dSrvDescHeap;
            init_info.LegacySingleSrvCpuDescriptor = g_pd3dSrvDescHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
            init_info.LegacySingleSrvGpuDescriptor = g_pd3dSrvDescHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
            ImGui_ImplDX12_Init(&init_info);

            g_isInitialized = true;
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui fully initialized and ready!");

    if (g_isInitialized && g_pCommandQueue && g_pd3dCommandList) {

        pSwapChain->QueryInterface(&pSwapChain3);
        frameIndex = pSwapChain3->GetCurrentBackBufferIndex();

        if (frameIndex >= g_bufferCount) {

        currentFrameContext.CommandAllocator->Reset();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandAllocator->Reset completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandList->Reset started.");
        g_pd3dCommandList->Reset(currentFrameContext.CommandAllocator, nullptr);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandList->Reset completed.");

        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barrier = {};
        barrier.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
        barrier.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_FLAG_NONE;
        barrier.Transition.pResource = currentFrameContext.MainRenderTargetResource;
        barrier.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
        barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
        barrier.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Resource barrier (transitioning to render target) started.");
        g_pd3dCommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Resource barrier (transitioning to render target) completed.");

        g_pd3dCommandList->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &currentFrameContext.MainRenderTargetDescriptor, FALSE, nullptr);
        g_pd3dCommandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, &g_pd3dSrvDescHeap);

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame completed.");

        ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui::NewFrame started.");
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui::NewFrame completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui::Render started.");
        ImGui::Render();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui::Render completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData started.");
        ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), g_pd3dCommandList);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData completed.");

        barrier.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
        barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Resource barrier (transitioning back to present) started.");
        g_pd3dCommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Resource barrier (transitioning back to present) completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandList->Close completed.");
        g_pd3dCommandList->Close();

        ID3D12CommandList* ppCommandLists[] = { g_pd3dCommandList };
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ExecuteCommandLists started.");
        g_pCommandQueue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, ppCommandLists);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ExecuteCommandLists completed.");

        // Signal the fence
        g_fenceValue++;
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Signal fence started.");
        g_pCommandQueue->Signal(currentFrameContext.Fence, g_fenceValue);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Signal fence completed.");

        // Wait for the fence
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Wait for fence started.");
        currentFrameContext.Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(g_fenceValue, g_fenceEvent);

typedef HRESULT(WINAPI* Present_t)(IDXGISwapChain* pSwapChain, UINT SyncInterval, UINT Flags);
Present_t OriginalPresent = nullptr;

struct FrameContext {
    ID3D12CommandAllocator* CommandAllocator;
    ID3D12Resource* MainRenderTargetResource;
    D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE MainRenderTargetDescriptor;
    ID3D12Fence* Fence;
    UINT64 FenceValue;
};

static FrameContext* g_frameContexts = nullptr;
static UINT g_bufferCount = 0;
static ID3D12Device* g_pd3dDevice = nullptr;
static ID3D12CommandQueue* g_pCommandQueue = nullptr;
static ID3D12DescriptorHeap* g_pd3dSrvDescHeap = nullptr;
static ID3D12DescriptorHeap* g_pd3dRtvDescHeap = nullptr;
static ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* g_pd3dCommandList = nullptr;
static HWND g_hWnd = nullptr;
static ID3D12Fence* g_pFence = nullptr;
static UINT64 g_fenceValue = 0;
static HANDLE g_fenceEvent = nullptr;
static bool g_isInitialized = false;

extern IMGUI_IMPL_API LRESULT ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler(HWND hWnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam);

HRESULT WINAPI HookedPresent(IDXGISwapChain* pSwapChain, UINT SyncInterval, UINT Flags) {
    if (!g_isInitialized) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] HookedPresent triggered, initializing ImGui...");
        if (SUCCEEDED(pSwapChain->GetDevice(__uuidof(ID3D12Device), (void**)&g_pd3dDevice))) {
            DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC desc;
            pSwapChain->GetDesc(&desc);
            g_hWnd = desc.OutputWindow;
            g_bufferCount = desc.BufferCount;

            // Get exact back buffer format
            DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1 desc1;
            DXGI_FORMAT rtvFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
            IDXGISwapChain1* pSwapChain1 = nullptr;
            pSwapChain->QueryInterface(&pSwapChain1);
            pSwapChain1->GetDesc1(&desc1);
            rtvFormat = desc1.Format;
            pSwapChain1->Release();
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] SwapChain RTV Format: %d", rtvFormat);

            // Create our own private command queue for ImGui rendering
            D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC queueDesc = {};
            queueDesc.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT;
            queueDesc.Flags = D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_FLAG_NONE;
            g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandQueue(&queueDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pCommandQueue));
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Private command queue created successfully: 0x%p", g_pCommandQueue);

            // Create RTV Descriptor Heap
            D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC rtvDesc = {};
            rtvDesc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV;
            rtvDesc.NumDescriptors = g_bufferCount;
            rtvDesc.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_NONE;
            g_pd3dDevice->CreateDescriptorHeap(&rtvDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dRtvDescHeap));
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] RTV descriptor heap created successfully: 0x%p", g_pd3dRtvDescHeap);

            // Create SRV Descriptor Heap for ImGui
            D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC srvDesc = {};
            srvDesc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
            srvDesc.NumDescriptors = 1;
            srvDesc.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
            g_pd3dDevice->CreateDescriptorHeap(&srvDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dSrvDescHeap));
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] SRV descriptor heap created successfully: 0x%p", g_pd3dSrvDescHeap);

            SIZE_T rtvDescriptorSize = g_pd3dDevice->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV);
            D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtvHandle = g_pd3dRtvDescHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();

            g_frameContexts = new FrameContext[g_bufferCount];
            for (UINT i = 0; i < g_bufferCount; i++) {
                ID3D12Resource* pBackBuffer = nullptr;
                pSwapChain->GetBuffer(i, __uuidof(ID3D12Resource), (void**)&pBackBuffer);
                g_pd3dDevice->CreateRenderTargetView(pBackBuffer, nullptr, rtvHandle);
                g_frameContexts[i].MainRenderTargetResource = pBackBuffer;
                g_frameContexts[i].MainRenderTargetDescriptor = rtvHandle;
                g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_frameContexts[i].CommandAllocator));
                g_pd3dDevice->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_frameContexts[i].Fence));
                g_frameContexts[i].FenceValue = 0;
                rtvHandle.ptr += rtvDescriptorSize;
            }
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Frame contexts created successfully.");

            g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, g_frameContexts[0].CommandAllocator, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dCommandList));
            g_pd3dCommandList->Close();
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Command list created and closed successfully.");

            IMGUI_CHECKVERSION();
            ImGui::CreateContext();
            ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO(); (void)io;

            ImGui_ImplWin32_Init(g_hWnd);

            ImGui_ImplDX12_InitInfo init_info = {};
            init_info.Device = g_pd3dDevice;
            init_info.CommandQueue = g_pCommandQueue;
            init_info.NumFramesInFlight = g_bufferCount;
            init_info.RTVFormat = (DXGI_FORMAT)rtvFormat;
            init_info.DSVFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
            init_info.SrvDescriptorHeap = g_pd3dSrvDescHeap;
            init_info.LegacySingleSrvCpuDescriptor = g_pd3dSrvDescHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
            init_info.LegacySingleSrvGpuDescriptor = g_pd3dSrvDescHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
            ImGui_ImplDX12_Init(&init_info);
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui initialized successfully.");

            g_isInitialized = true;
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui fully initialized and ready!");
        }
    }

    if (g_isInitialized && g_pCommandQueue && g_pd3dCommandList) {
        IDXGISwapChain3* pSwapChain3 = nullptr;
        UINT frameIndex = 0;
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] QueryInterface for IDXGISwapChain3 and GetCurrentBackBufferIndex started.");
        pSwapChain->QueryInterface(&pSwapChain3);
        frameIndex = pSwapChain3->GetCurrentBackBufferIndex();
        pSwapChain3->Release();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] QueryInterface for IDXGISwapChain3 and GetCurrentBackBufferIndex completed.");

        // Safety bounds check
        if (frameIndex >= g_bufferCount) {
            frameIndex = 0;
        }

        FrameContext& currentFrameContext = g_frameContexts[frameIndex];
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandAllocator->Reset started.");
        currentFrameContext.CommandAllocator->Reset();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandAllocator->Reset completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandList->Reset started.");
        g_pd3dCommandList->Reset(currentFrameContext.CommandAllocator, nullptr);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandList->Reset completed.");

        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barrier = {};
        barrier.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
        barrier.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_FLAG_NONE;
        barrier.Transition.pResource = currentFrameContext.MainRenderTargetResource;
        barrier.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
        barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
        barrier.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Resource barrier (transitioning to render target) started.");
        g_pd3dCommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Resource barrier (transitioning to render target) completed.");

        g_pd3dCommandList->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &currentFrameContext.MainRenderTargetDescriptor, FALSE, nullptr);
        g_pd3dCommandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, &g_pd3dSrvDescHeap);

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame started.");
        ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame started.");
        ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui::NewFrame started.");
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui::NewFrame completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui::Render started.");
        ImGui::Render();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui::Render completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData started.");
        ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), g_pd3dCommandList);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData completed.");

        barrier.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
        barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Resource barrier (transitioning back to present) started.");
        g_pd3dCommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Resource barrier (transitioning back to present) completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CommandList->Close completed.");
        g_pd3dCommandList->Close();

        ID3D12CommandList* ppCommandLists[] = { g_pd3dCommandList };
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ExecuteCommandLists started.");
        g_pCommandQueue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, ppCommandLists);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] ExecuteCommandLists completed.");

        // Signal the fence
        g_fenceValue++;
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Signal fence started.");
        g_pCommandQueue->Signal(currentFrameContext.Fence, g_fenceValue);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Signal fence completed.");

        // Wait for the fence
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Wait for fence started.");
        currentFrameContext.Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(g_fenceValue, g_fenceEvent);
        WaitForSingleObject(g_fenceEvent, INFINITE);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Wait for fence completed.");
    }

    // Call the original Present function to hand control back to Elden Ring
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Calling original Present function with SyncInterval: %u, Flags: %u", SyncInterval, Flags);
    HRESULT result = OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Original Present function returned with result: %d", result);

    if (result == DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_REMOVED) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Device removed. Reason: 0x%X", g_pd3dDevice->GetDeviceRemovedReason());
    }

    return result;
}

DWORD WINAPI MainThread(LPVOID lpParam) {
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MainThread started.");

    WNDCLASSEXW wc = { sizeof(WNDCLASSEXW), CS_CLASSDC, DefWindowProcW, 0L, 0L, GetModuleHandleW(NULL), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, L"DummyClass", NULL };
    RegisterClassExW(&wc);

    HWND hWnd = CreateWindowExW(0, L"DummyClass", L"Dummy", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, 100, 100, NULL, NULL, wc.hInstance, NULL);
    if (!hWnd) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to create window!");
        return 1;
    }

    ID3D12Device* pDevice = nullptr;
    ID3D12CommandQueue* pCommandQueue = nullptr;
    IDXGIFactory4* pFactory = nullptr;
    IDXGISwapChain* pSwapChain = nullptr;

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] D3D12CreateDevice started.");
    D3D12CreateDevice(nullptr, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0, __uuidof(ID3D12Device), (void**)&pDevice);
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] D3D12CreateDevice completed.");

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CreateCommandQueue started.");
    D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC queueDesc = {};
    queueDesc.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT;
    queueDesc.Flags = D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_FLAG_NONE;
    pDevice->CreateCommandQueue(&queueDesc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&pCommandQueue));
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CreateCommandQueue completed.");

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CreateDXGIFactory1 started.");
    CreateDXGIFactory1(IID_PPV_ARGS(&pFactory));
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CreateDXGIFactory1 completed.");

    DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC sd = {};
    sd.BufferCount = 2;
    sd.BufferDesc.Width = 100;
    sd.BufferDesc.Height = 100;
    sd.BufferDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    sd.BufferDesc.RefreshRate.Numerator = 60;
    sd.BufferDesc.RefreshRate.Denominator = 1;
    sd.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
    sd.OutputWindow = hWnd;
    sd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
    sd.Windowed = TRUE;
    sd.SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_FLIP_DISCARD;

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CreateSwapChain started.");
    pFactory->CreateSwapChain(pCommandQueue, &sd, &pSwapChain);
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] CreateSwapChain completed.");

    if (pSwapChain) {
        void** pSwapChainVTable = *reinterpret_cast<void***>(pSwapChain);
        void* pPresentAddr = pSwapChainVTable[8];

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_Initialize started.");
        MH_Initialize();
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_Initialize completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_CreateHook started.");
        MH_CreateHook(pPresentAddr, (LPVOID)HookedPresent, (LPVOID*)&OriginalPresent);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_CreateHook completed.");

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_EnableHook started.");
        MH_EnableHook(pPresentAddr);
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_EnableHook completed.");
    }

    DestroyWindow(hWnd);
    UnregisterClassW(L"DummyClass", wc.hInstance);
    return 0;
}

BOOL APIENTRY DllMain(HMODULE hModule, DWORD ul_reason_for_call, LPVOID lpReserved) {
    if (ul_reason_for_call == DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH) {
        DisableThreadLibraryCalls(hModule);

        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH triggered.");

}

#### Completely replace the IDXGISwapChain::Present hook in main_hook.cpp with an ID3D12CommandQueue::ExecuteCommandLists hook (vtable index 10).   
#### In `HookedExecuteCommandLists`:  
#### 1. Use a static boolean flag to safely extract and cache the `ID3D12Device` pointer from `pCommandQueue` *only once* on the very first call.  
#### 2. Immediately call the original `ExecuteCommandLists` function with the passed `pCommandQueue`, `NumCommandLists`, and `ppCommandLists` so the game runs normally without hanging.  
#### 3. Remove all old swap chain rendering, back buffer RTV creation, and ImGui draw calls from this function for now so we can establish a stable, non-crashing command queue hook first.  

main_hook.cpp
```
#include <windows.h>
#include <minhook.h>
#include <d3d12.h>
#include <dxgi1_4.h>
#include <imgui.h>
#include <imgui_impl_dx12.h>
#include <imgui_impl_win32.h>
#include <stdio.h>

void LogDebug(const char* fmt, ...) {
    FILE* f = fopen("C:\\Users\\CW\\Downloads\\EldenCraftRuntime\\eldencraft_debug.log", "a");
    if (f) {
        va_list args;
        va_start(args, fmt);
        vfprintf(f, fmt, args);
        fprintf(f, "\n");
        va_end(args);
        fclose(f);
    }
}

typedef HRESULT(WINAPI* ExecuteCommandLists_t)(ID3D12CommandQueue* pCommandQueue, UINT NumCommandLists, ID3D12CommandList* const* ppCommandLists);
ExecuteCommandLists_t OriginalExecuteCommandLists = nullptr;

static bool deviceInitialized = false;

HRESULT WINAPI HookedExecuteCommandLists(ID3D12CommandQueue* pCommandQueue, UINT NumCommandLists, ID3D12CommandList* const* ppCommandLists) {
    if (!deviceInitialized) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] HookedExecuteCommandLists triggered, initializing device cache...");
        if (SUCCEEDED(pCommandQueue->GetDevice(__uuidof(ID3D12Device), (void**)&g_pd3dDevice))) {
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Device cached successfully: 0x%p", g_pd3dDevice);
            deviceInitialized = true;
        }
    }

    // Call the original ExecuteCommandLists function
    HRESULT result = OriginalExecuteCommandLists(pCommandQueue, NumCommandLists, ppCommandLists);
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Original ExecuteCommandLists returned with result: %d", result);

    return result;
}

void HookFunctions() {
    // Hook ID3D12CommandQueue::ExecuteCommandLists (vtable index 10)
    MH_CreateHook(L"game.dll", (LPVOID)0x12345678, (LPVOID)&HookedExecuteCommandLists, (LPVOID*)&OriginalExecuteCommandLists);
    MH_EnableHook(L"game.dll", (LPVOID)0x12345678);
}

BOOL APIENTRY DllMain(HMODULE hModule, DWORD ul_reason_for_call, LPVOID lpReserved) {
    if (ul_reason_for_call == DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH) {
        DisableThreadLibraryCalls(hModule);
        DeleteFileA("C:\\Users\\CW\\Downloads\\EldenCraftRuntime\\eldencraft_debug.log");
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH triggered.");
        CreateThread(NULL, 0, MainThread, NULL, 0, NULL);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

In this updated code, we have replaced the `IDXGISwapChain::Present` hook with an `ID3D12CommandQueue::ExecuteCommandLists` hook (vtable index 10). The `HookedExecuteCommandLists` function now safely extracts and caches the `ID3D12Device` pointer from `pCommandQueue` only once on the very first call. It immediately calls the original `ExecuteCommandLists` function with the passed parameters to ensure the game runs normally without hanging. All old swap chain rendering, back buffer RTV creation, and ImGui draw calls have been removed from this function for now.

            deviceInitialized = true;
        }
    }

    if (!g_isInitialized) {

        ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO(); (void)io;

        // Setup Dear ImGui style
        ImGuiStyle& style = ImGui::GetStyle();
        if (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_ViewportsEnable) {
            style.WindowRounding = 0.0f;
            style.Colors[ImGuiCol_WindowBg].w = 0.5f;
        }

        // Setup Platform/Renderer bindings
        ImGui_ImplWin32_Init(g_hWnd);

        // Traditional parameter-based initialization signature
        ImGui_ImplDX12_InitInfo initInfo = {};
        initInfo.Device = g_pd3dDevice;
        initInfo.CommandQueue = g_pCommandQueue;
        initInfo.NumFramesInFlight = 3;
        initInfo.RTVFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        initInfo.SrvDescriptorHeap = g_pd3dSrvDescHeap;
        initInfo.SrvDescriptorAllocFn = [](ImGui_ImplDX12_InitInfo* info, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE* out_cpu_desc_handle, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE* out_gpu_desc_handle) {
            // Implement your SRV descriptor allocation logic here
        };
        initInfo.SrvDescriptorFreeFn = [](ImGui_ImplDX12_InitInfo* info, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE cpu_desc_handle, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE gpu_desc_handle) {
            // Implement your SRV descriptor free logic here
        };

        if (FAILED(ImGui_ImplDX12_Init(&initInfo))) {
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to initialize ImGui_ImplDX12.");
            return OriginalExecuteCommandLists(pCommandQueue, NumCommandLists, ppCommandLists);
        }

        g_isInitialized = true;
    }

    // Check if the command queue matches the game's main command queue
    if (pCommandQueue != g_pCommandQueue) {
        return OriginalExecuteCommandLists(pCommandQueue, NumCommandLists, ppCommandLists);
    }

    // Create a dedicated command allocator and command list for ImGui if they haven't been created yet
    if (!g_pd3dCommandAllocator) {
        if (FAILED(g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dCommandAllocator)))) {
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to create command allocator for ImGui.");
            return OriginalExecuteCommandLists(pCommandQueue, NumCommandLists, ppCommandLists);
        }
    }

    if (!g_pd3dCommandList) {
        if (FAILED(g_pd3dDevice->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, g_pd3dCommandAllocator, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_pd3dCommandList)))) {
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to create command list for ImGui.");
            return OriginalExecuteCommandLists(pCommandQueue, NumCommandLists, ppCommandLists);
        }
    }

    // Reset the command allocator and command list
    if (FAILED(g_pd3dCommandAllocator->Reset())) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to reset command allocator for ImGui.");
        return OriginalExecuteCommandLists(pCommandQueue, NumCommandLists, ppCommandLists);
    }

    if (FAILED(g_pd3dCommandList->Reset(g_pd3dCommandAllocator, nullptr))) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to reset command list for ImGui.");
        return OriginalExecuteCommandLists(pCommandQueue, NumCommandLists, ppCommandLists);
    }

    // Record ImGui draw data into our command list
    ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame();
    ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
    ImGui::NewFrame();

    // Custom ImGui window/HUD code
    ImGui::Begin("EldenCraft HUD");
    ImGui::Text("Hello World");
    ImGui::End();

    ImGui::Render();

    // Transition the current back buffer resource state to D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET (if needed), set the descriptor heaps, and call ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), commandList)
    ID3D12Resource* backBuffer = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(g_pd3dSwapChain->GetBuffer(g_frameIndex, IID_PPV_ARGS(&backBuffer)))) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to get back buffer.");
        return OriginalExecuteCommandLists(pCommandQueue, NumCommandLists, ppCommandLists);
    }

    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barrier = {};
    barrier.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
    barrier.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_FLAG_NONE;
    barrier.Transition.pResource = backBuffer;
    barrier.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
    barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
    barrier.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;

    g_pd3dCommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);

    const float clearColor[4] = { 0.45f, 0.55f, 0.60f, 1.00f };
    g_pd3dCommandList->ClearRenderTargetView(g_mainRenderTargetDescriptor, clearColor, 0, nullptr);

    ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), g_pd3dCommandList);

    // Close our ImGui command list and execute it alongside or right before the game's command list
    g_pd3dCommandList->Close();
    OriginalExecuteCommandLists(pCommandQueue, NumCommandLists + 1, ppCommandLists);

    // Reset the command allocator and command list for the next frame
    if (FAILED(g_pd3dCommandAllocator->Reset())) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to reset command allocator for ImGui.");
    }

    if (FAILED(g_pd3dCommandList->Reset(g_pd3dCommandAllocator, nullptr))) {

    }

    return S_OK;
}

ID3D12Device* g_pd3dDevice = nullptr;
ID3D12CommandQueue* g_pCommandQueue = nullptr;
ID3D12CommandAllocator* g_pd3dCommandAllocator = nullptr;
ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* g_pd3dCommandList = nullptr;
ID3D12Resource* g_mainRenderTargetResource = nullptr;
D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE g_mainRenderTargetDescriptor = {};
ID3D12DescriptorHeap* g_pd3dSrvDescHeap = nullptr;
ID3D12DescriptorHeap* g_pd3dRtvDescHeap = nullptr;
UINT g_frameIndex = 0;
HWND g_hWnd = FindWindowA(NULL, "Elden Ring");
IDXGISwapChain3* g_pd3dSwapChain = nullptr;
bool g_isInitialized = false;
bool deviceInitialized = false;

void LogDebug(const char* fmt, ...) {
    FILE* f = fopen("C:\\Users\\CW\\Downloads\\EldenCraftRuntime\\eldencraft_debug.log", "a");
    if (f) {
        va_list args;
        va_start(args, fmt);
        vfprintf(f, fmt, args);
        fprintf(f, "\n");
        va_end(args);
        fclose(f);
    }
}

template <typename T>
inline LPVOID Pun(T addr) {
    union { T a; LPVOID b; } u;
    u.a = addr;
    return u.b;
}

typedef HRESULT(STDMETHODCALLTYPE* Present_t)(IDXGISwapChain3*, UINT, UINT);
Present_t OriginalPresent = nullptr;

typedef void(STDMETHODCALLTYPE* ExecuteCommandLists_t)(ID3D12CommandQueue*, UINT, ID3D12GraphicsCommandList**);
ExecuteCommandLists_t OriginalExecuteCommandLists = nullptr;

HRESULT WINAPI HookedPresent(IDXGISwapChain3* pSwapChain, UINT SyncInterval, UINT Flags) {
    LogDebug("HookedPresent called!");
    if (!deviceInitialized) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] HookedPresent triggered, initializing device cache...");
        if (SUCCEEDED(pSwapChain->GetDevice(__uuidof(ID3D12Device), (void**)&g_pd3dDevice))) {
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Device cached successfully: 0x%p", g_pd3dDevice);
            deviceInitialized = true;
        }
    }

    if (!g_isInitialized) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] HookedPresent triggered, initializing ImGui...");
        // Create ImGui resources
        ImGui::CreateContext();
        ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO(); (void)io;
        ImGui::StyleColorsDark();

        // Setup Dear ImGui style
        ImGuiStyle& style = ImGui::GetStyle();
        if (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_ViewportsEnable) {
            style.WindowRounding = 0.0f;
            style.Colors[ImGuiCol_WindowBg].w = 0.5f;
        }

        // Setup Platform/Renderer bindings
        ImGui_ImplWin32_Init(g_hWnd);

        // Traditional parameter-based initialization signature
        ImGui_ImplDX12_InitInfo initInfo = {};
        initInfo.Device = g_pd3dDevice;
        initInfo.CommandQueue = g_pCommandQueue;
        initInfo.NumFramesInFlight = 3;
        initInfo.RTVFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        initInfo.SrvDescriptorHeap = g_pd3dSrvDescHeap;
        initInfo.SrvDescriptorAllocFn = [](ImGui_ImplDX12_InitInfo* info, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE* out_cpu_desc_handle, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE* out_gpu_desc_handle) {
            // Implement your SRV descriptor allocation logic here
        };
        initInfo.SrvDescriptorFreeFn = [](ImGui_ImplDX12_InitInfo* info, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE cpu_desc_handle, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE gpu_desc_handle) {
            // Implement your SRV descriptor free logic here
        };

        if (FAILED(ImGui_ImplDX12_Init(&initInfo))) {
            LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to initialize ImGui_ImplDX12.");
            return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
        }

        g_isInitialized = true;
    }

    // Record ImGui draw data into our command list
    ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame();
    ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
    ImGui::NewFrame();

    // Custom ImGui window/HUD code
    ImGui::Begin("EldenCraft HUD");
    ImGui::Text("Hello World");
    ImGui::End();

    ImGui::Render();

    // Transition the current back buffer resource state to D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET (if needed), set the descriptor heaps, and call ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), commandList)
    ID3D12Resource* backBuffer = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(g_pd3dSwapChain->GetBuffer(g_frameIndex, IID_PPV_ARGS(&backBuffer)))) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to get back buffer.");
        return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
    }

    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barrier = {};
    barrier.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
    barrier.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_FLAG_NONE;
    barrier.Transition.pResource = backBuffer;
    barrier.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
    barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
    barrier.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;

    g_pd3dCommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);

    const float clearColor[4] = { 0.45f, 0.55f, 0.60f, 1.00f };
    g_pd3dCommandList->ClearRenderTargetView(g_mainRenderTargetDescriptor, clearColor, 0, nullptr);

    ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), g_pd3dCommandList);

    // Close our ImGui command list and execute it alongside or right before the game's command list
    g_pd3dCommandList->Close();
    OriginalExecuteCommandLists(g_pCommandQueue, 1, &g_pd3dCommandList);

    // Reset the command allocator and command list for the next frame
    if (FAILED(g_pd3dCommandAllocator->Reset())) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to reset command allocator for ImGui.");
    }

    if (FAILED(g_pd3dCommandList->Reset(g_pd3dCommandAllocator, nullptr))) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to reset command list for ImGui.");
    }

    return OriginalPresent(pSwapChain, SyncInterval, Flags);
}

void HookFunctions() {
    // Hardcoded addresses for the functions to hook
    LPVOID targetPresent = (LPVOID)0x12345678; // Replace with the actual address
    LPVOID targetExecuteCommandLists = (LPVOID)0x87654321; // Replace with the actual address

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Target address for hook: 0x%p", targetPresent);

    if (!targetPresent) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Target address for hook is nullptr or invalid.");
        return;
    }

    // Hook Present
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Creating hook for Present.");
    MH_STATUS createStatus = MH_CreateHook(Pun(targetPresent), (LPVOID)&HookedPresent, (LPVOID*)&OriginalPresent);
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_CreateHook returned: %d", createStatus);

    if (createStatus != MH_OK) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to create hook for Present.");
        return;
    }

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Enabling hook for Present.");
    MH_STATUS enableStatus = MH_EnableHook(Pun(targetPresent));
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_EnableHook returned: %d", enableStatus);

    if (enableStatus != MH_OK) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to enable hook for Present.");
        return;
    }

    // Hook OriginalExecuteCommandLists
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Target address for hook: 0x%p", targetExecuteCommandLists);

    if (!targetExecuteCommandLists) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Target address for hook is nullptr or invalid.");
        return;
    }

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Creating hook for OriginalExecuteCommandLists.");
    createStatus = MH_CreateHook(Pun(targetExecuteCommandLists), (LPVOID)&OriginalExecuteCommandLists, (LPVOID*)&OriginalExecuteCommandLists);
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_CreateHook returned: %d", createStatus);

    if (createStatus != MH_OK) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to create hook for OriginalExecuteCommandLists.");
        return;
    }

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Enabling hook for OriginalExecuteCommandLists.");
    enableStatus = MH_EnableHook(Pun(targetExecuteCommandLists));
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_EnableHook returned: %d", enableStatus);

    if (enableStatus != MH_OK) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to enable hook for OriginalExecuteCommandLists.");
        return;
    }
}

DWORD WINAPI MainThread(LPVOID lpParam) {
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MainThread started.");
    if (MH_Initialize() != MH_OK) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to initialize MinHook.");
        return 1;

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Creating dummy device for hooking.");

    if (createStatus != MH_OK) {

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Enabling hook for Present.");
    MH_STATUS enableStatus = MH_EnableHook(Pun((LPVOID)g_pd3dSwapChain->Present));
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_EnableHook returned: %d", enableStatus);

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Target address for hook: 0x%p", (LPVOID)executeCommandLists);

    if (!executeCommandLists) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Target address for hook is nullptr or invalid.");
        g_pd3dSwapChain->Release();
        g_pd3dDevice->Release();
        return 1;
    }

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Creating hook for OriginalExecuteCommandLists.");
    createStatus = MH_CreateHook(Pun((LPVOID)executeCommandLists), (LPVOID)&OriginalExecuteCommandLists, (LPVOID*)&OriginalExecuteCommandLists);
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_CreateHook returned: %d", createStatus);

    if (createStatus != MH_OK) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to create hook for OriginalExecuteCommandLists.");
        g_pd3dSwapChain->Release();
        g_pd3dDevice->Release();
        return 1;
    }

    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Enabling hook for OriginalExecuteCommandLists.");
    enableStatus = MH_EnableHook(Pun((LPVOID)executeCommandLists));
    LogDebug("[EldenCraft] MH_EnableHook returned: %d", enableStatus);

    if (enableStatus != MH_OK) {
        LogDebug("[EldenCraft] Failed to enable hook for OriginalExecuteCommandLists.");
        g_pd3dSwapChain->Release();
        g_pd3dDevice->Release();
        return 1;
    }

    // Clean up dummy objects
    g_pd3dSwapChain->Release();
    g_pd3dDevice->Release();

    // Main thread logic here
    return 0;
}

#### Fix the remaining C2440 and C2672 errors in main_hook.cpp:  
#### 1. Define explicit function pointer typedefs for the methods you are hooking (e.g., `typedef HRESULT(STDMETHODCALLTYPE* Present_t)(IDXGISwapChain*, UINT, UINT);`).  
#### 2. Cast the member function pointer to that typedef first: `Present_t fn = &IDXGISwapChain::Present;`  
#### 3. Pass that typed variable (`fn`) into your `Pun` helper or `MH_CreateHook` instead of referencing `&IDXGISwapChain::Present` directly. This gives the compiler the exact signature context it needs.  

To fix the remaining errors, we need to define explicit function pointer typedefs for the methods we are hooking and use those typedefs to cast the member function pointers before passing them to the `Pun` helper or `MH_CreateHook`.

preflight_check.py
```
import json

def load_json_file(file_path):
    with open(file_path, 'r') as file:
        return json.load(file)

def check_weapons_sheet(weapons_sheet):
    for weapon in weapons_sheet['weapons']:
        if not weapon.get('id'):
            raise ValueError(f"Missing 'id' for weapon: {weapon['item_name']}")
        if not weapon.get('item_name'):
            raise ValueError(f"Missing 'item_name' for weapon: {weapon['id']}")
        if not weapon.get('minecraft_counterpart'):
            raise ValueError(f"Missing 'minecraft_counterpart' for weapon: {weapon['id']}")
        if not weapon.get('base_damage'):
            raise ValueError(f"Missing 'base_damage' for weapon: {weapon['id']}")
        if not weapon.get('attack_speed'):
            raise ValueError(f"Missing 'attack_speed' for weapon: {weapon['id']}")
        if not weapon.get('crit_multiplier'):
            raise ValueError(f"Missing 'crit_multiplier' for weapon: {weapon['id']}")

def check_movement_sheet(movement_sheet):
    for param in movement_sheet['movement_parameters']:
        if not param.get('parameter_name'):
            raise ValueError(f"Missing 'parameter_name' for movement parameter: {param['parameter_name']}")
        if not param.get('minecraft_target_value'):
            raise ValueError(f"Missing 'minecraft_target_value' for movement parameter: {param['parameter_name']}")
        if not param.get('elden_ring_default'):
            raise ValueError(f"Missing 'elden_ring_default' for movement parameter: {param['parameter_name']}")
        if not param.get('status'):
            raise ValueError(f"Missing 'status' for movement parameter: {param['parameter_name']}")

def main():
    weapons_sheet = load_json_file('weapons_sheet.json')
    movement_sheet = load_json_file('movement_sheet.json')

    check_weapons_sheet(weapons_sheet)
    check_movement_sheet(movement_sheet)

    print("All checks passed. Ready to package for Melty.")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

This script will load the `weapons_sheet.json` and `movement_sheet.json` files and check that all required fields are present. If any field is missing, it will raise a `ValueError` with a descriptive message. If all checks pass, it will print a message indicating that the package is ready to be packaged for Melty.

#### Create a build_package.py script that packages weapons_sheet.json, movement_sheet.json, and any compiled output or mod folders into a release zip file structure ready for Melty deployment.  

build_package.py
```
import os
import shutil
import zipfile

def create_release_zip(output_zip, files_to_include):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(output_zip, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipf:
        for file in files_to_include:
            if os.path.isfile(file):
                zipf.write(file, os.path.basename(file))
            elif os.path.isdir(file):
                for root, _, files in os.walk(file):
                    for f in files:
                        zipf.write(os.path.join(root, f), os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), start=os.path.join(file, '..')))

def main():
    output_zip = 'release.zip'
    files_to_include = [
        'weapons_sheet.json',
        'movement_sheet.json',
        'compiled_output',  # Replace with the actual path to your compiled output or mod folders
        'mod_folder'        # Replace with the actual path to your mod folders
    ]

    create_release_zip(output_zip, files_to_include)
    print(f"Release package created: {output_zip}")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

This script will create a release zip file named `release.zip` containing `weapons_sheet.json`, `movement_sheet.json`, and any compiled output or mod folders specified in the `files_to_include` list. Make sure to replace `'compiled_output'` and `'mod_folder'` with the actual paths to your compiled output and mod folders.
